hook: Tuist 4.218 brings coverage to Rust crates

beats.say: Version 4.218 of Tuist is out today. The tuist cargo command now reports code coverage, scoped to your own crates rather than every dependency.
Tuist share can now attach an icon to executable previews, one of four changes listed in the Tuist release announcement.
You can sign in with workload identities, so there is no token to manage, and shard downloads now resume after an interruption instead of starting over.
